our_interpretation: The claim concerns the purpose of the February 2, 2026 merger, not a forecast.
A bailout means financial support intended to relieve substantial financial distress. It need not involve insolvency or a cash purchase price.
High spending and access to a larger company's resources are relevant but do not, alone, establish a rescue motive.
The surrounding discussion relies on financial reporting, so the implied financial basis is estimate. Marcus specifies no cash amount.
criteria.support_condition: Transaction records or well-sourced reporting establish that relieving xAI's financial distress through substantial financial support was a material purpose of the merger.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish that xAI was not financially distressed and that the transaction did not provide or arrange material financial support for it.
